name: Casluhim
title: Peoples descended from Mizraim
summary: Casluhim was one of the peoples descended from Mizraim (Egypt) in the table of nations. According to the text, the Philistines came from this people.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the table of nations
keyEvents.description: Casluhim is listed among Mizraim's descendants, and the text notes that the Philistines came from this people.
